searchText: Do you have specific comments on what's better? Better compiler/vs code extensions, math support (with any module crate too), standardized error/revert messages using crates to start with I also like traits + structs + impl better for complex data types Also just the main language used by top other chains in general Overall dev experience is still better on EVM tho but can't say for what that might be like a year from now Doing a write up on this rn Nice. I would like to read it after it's finished!
